title: inkGround: Benchmarking Fine-grained Visual Grounding Capabilities of Vision-Language Models for Cursive Handwriting in the Wild
abstract: arXiv:2610.38720v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Human handwriting is produced as an ordered sequence of pen movements, but an offline image keeps only the final ink. Handwriting trajectory recovery aims to restore the ordered stroke points and their pen-up/pen-down transitions. Existing image-trajectory pair datasets are recorded with digitizing tablets under controlled conditions, which limits writer coverage and stylistic diversity. Moreover, there is no benchmark that measures the visual grounding capabilities of general-purpose Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for the stroke trajectory recovery task. In this work, we introduce inkGround, a benchmark for stroke trajectory recovery from full-page, camera-captured handwriting. inkGround pairs 537 page images (~18.7k words, ~163k strokes) with reference trajectories produced by a pretrained offline-to-online model, filtered by OCR agreement, and verified by human raters. translated_title: inkGround：面向真实场景手写连笔字的视觉-语言模型细粒度视觉定位能力基准测试
translated_abstract: 人类的书写是作为有顺序的笔尖移动序列而产生的，但离线图像仅保留了最终的墨迹。手写轨迹恢复旨在还原有序的笔画点及其抬笔/落笔状态转换。现有的图像-轨迹配对数据集是在受控条件下使用数位板录制的，这限制了书写者的覆盖范围和风格多样性。此外，目前尚无基准来衡量通用视觉-语言模型（VLM）在笔画轨迹恢复任务上的视觉定位能力。在这项工作中，我们提出了inkGround，一个针对整页、相机拍摄手写体的笔画轨迹恢复基准。inkGround将537张页面图像（约1.87万个单词，约16.3万个笔画）与由预训练的离线到在线模型生成的参考轨迹配对，通过OCR一致性进行过滤，并经人工评估者验证。由于这些参考是基于伪标签的，其代表的是一种可能的轨迹解…
tldr: 提出inkGround基准，利用537张相机拍摄的真实手写页面图像（含约16.3万个笔画），评估视觉-语言模型在手写轨迹恢复这一细粒度视觉定位任务上的能力。
en_tdlr: We introduce inkGround, a benchmark that evaluates the fine-grained visual grounding capabilities of Vision-Language Models on stroke trajectory recovery from full-page, camera-captured handwriting in the wild.
